trace.model.cab.x: cab-car positions along the train, fifth pass: the diagram draws the cab end too short. Two photos put the face further ahead of door 1 than the diagram: pemr (158866 nearly side-on), a 1D projective fit along the bodyside through door 1's edges and nine window fronts (residuals 0-12 cm, typically 3) puts the face's side corner at -0.25 m and the cab window 0.12-0.90 m in the diagram's frame, i.e. the face 0.40 m further forward (its side corner is 0.15 m behind the tip); pgw (camera from the bodyside, lamps held out) wants the face 0.47-0.65 m forward, less reliably (its lamps come out 0.17 m apart in height left to right, so it is not pinned off the side). Applied: 0.40 m, the cab section 0..1.267 m stretched to 0..1.667 m (the cab side window and the cab-end paint with it) and everything from door 1 back moved 0.40 m; the cab car is 0.40 m longer (22.69 m, against 22.57 published over the gangway frame: the remaining 0.12 m is within the diagram's scale doubt).
trace.face.coupler: second reading, pgw low158 grid against the face scale (head lamps 545 px apart = 1.874 m, 291 px/m; lamp row 1082 px = 1.748 m, 311 px/m down): the dark opening between the yellow skirts runs from row 1340 (0.92 m) to 1500 (0.40 m), 230 px (0.79 m) wide at the top, 140 px (0.48 m) at the foot; the drawgear inside is a smaller grey shape ~0.36 m wide, 0.50-0.85 m. The first two builds drew it 1.06-0.84 m wide from 1.05 m: read off the wider shadow ; checked through the pgw camera: the opening traced on the photo at full resolution, top 550-805 px at row 1330, foot 580-770 at row 1500, and ours projected, top 569-801 at 1332-1340, foot 610-752 at ~1497: within 30 px (~9 cm) everywhere
trace.face.gangwayFrame.check: checked through the pgw camera: the frame's outer edges at +-0.55 m land within ~20 px (~5 cm) of the photo's grey frame; the width is right, the photo's frame is grimy mid grey where ours is black
trace.face.gangwayFrame.color: grimy mid grey: pgw medians on the frame's two sides (57,54,52) and (75,73,76): #42403F (was black)
trace.liveries.SW.branding: the one-line arrow + 'South Western Railway' on the navy below the windows (p002, lg159 grid): its ends 1730 and 2006 px read on the bodyside plane through the p002 camera (held-out windows 0.2-1.6 cm): 3.41-7.54 m, top and foot 1.85/1.48 m; traced off the same photo into logos/SW-oneline.svg (the published SW.svg is the two-line stacked logo, not what the 159 carries), aspect 11.57, so 0.357 m high, centred 5.47/1.665; white (the arrow's light blue not separated) ; second pass: the arrow and the wordmark traced separately (logos/SW-arrow.svg, SW-oneline.svg) so the arrow keeps its light blue (its pixels' median on p002 (174,243,251), #AEF3FB): the arrow 1727-1753 px = 3.38-3.73 m, rows 1168-1262, centred 1.627 m; the wordmark from 1758 px = 3.74-7.57 m, 0.372 m high at its traced aspect 10.28, centred 1.70 m
